title: US vows 'economic asphyxiation' of Iran with new sanctions
subhead: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent declared the US would launch an 'economic asphyxiation' on Iran in a press conference on Monday. Iran said it would retaliate against countries cooperating with the US.

Donald Trump undermines surrogacy for foreign nationals in the United States
subhead: A recent executive order from the US president ends the right to American citizenship for children born via surrogacy when the intended parents are foreign nationals. Washington's main targets are Chinese nationals, the largest group using US surrogacy services, followed by the French.

title: 'The hens suffocated': Fewer, smaller eggs are the double effect of France's scorching summer
subhead: Episodes of extreme heat have exposed stark differences in how well poultry farms are equipped to adapt, with up to 2% of the country’s laying hens dying during the June heatwave alone. Beyond excess mortality, the heat also reduces egg production and results in smaller eggs, causing further losses for farmers.

title: Want peace and quiet in France? These are the best places to buy property
subhead: For many people in France, the goal is to hear only the sounds of nature and to avoid being caught up in a tide of tourists. The good news is that in most areas where peace and quiet can still be found, real estate prices remain low.

title: Mexico's tourist beaches grapple with sargassum crisis
